resources.allowTrivial: The gap starts near zero and the proof is that it STAYS there across twelve seconds of walking over uneven ground. Rapier stores a heightfield column-major with rows along z; transpose it and the collider becomes the valley reflected about its diagonal, which looks correct from above and reads metres here. A bound that never trips is the whole assertion.

Wide bounds on purpose: this asserts the walker is still INSIDE the valley after a minute of walking, which a runaway controller or a collider it can fall through would break. The distance it covered is the movement row; this is the containment.
